cache.title: Prompt caching
cache.description: Hit rate is the share of prompt tokens read from the provider cache. Savings compare billed cost with the same prompt tokens at the full input price, net of cache writes. Gateway response cache hits are not included; they are reported on the Response cache page.
cache.empty: No prompt cache reads or writes in this period.

labels.keyHint: Groups spend by the values of this request label.
labels.byLabelHint: Requests without this label count as No label, so the rows add up to the totals above.
labels.empty: No label keys yet. Requests keep labels only for keys listed here.
labels.full: This list holds at most {max, number, integer} keys. Remove one to add another.
labels.problem: {problem, select, listed {This key is already allowed.} other {Use lowercase letters, digits, and underscores, and start with a letter.}}
labels.howTo: Clients send labels as one header per label (X-LLMHub-Label-Cost-Center: 4711), as one header for several (X-LLMHub-Labels: cost_center=4711,env=prod), in metadata on Chat Completions and Responses, or as tags entries such as cost_center:4711. Dashes in keys count as underscores.
labels.limits: Only listed keys are stored. A request keeps at most {labels, number, integer} labels, keys have up to {keyLength, number, integer} characters, and values are cut at {valueLength, number, integer} characters. Values are masked like the request content when a PII policy applies.
labels.keyRule: Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores, starting with a letter, up to {max, number, integer} characters. Dashes become underscores.
